title: Before someone makes the long drive.

slides.headline: It's a long way out.
slides.body: Before a technician heads to a remote site, the equipment state matters.

slides.headline: What needs their attention now?
slides.body: Choose the fault or threshold messages that change the next maintenance decision.

slides.headline: Give critical messages a plan.
slides.body: Define retries and a satellite exception path around urgency, power and payload.

slides.headline: The machine still needs a plan.
slides.body: Keep safe local control independent of connectivity, and make missing data visible.

slides.headline: Start with one real exception.
slides.body: Bring its trigger, response and device constraints to a design review.

technicalNotes.headline: What condition deserves attention now?
technicalNotes.body: Start with decisions—not dashboards or data volume.

technicalNotes.headline: What can wait?
technicalNotes.body: Routine telemetry may retry or batch. Exceptions may need another path.

technicalNotes.headline: What should the device do locally?
technicalNotes.body: Connectivity cannot replace safe local control and fault handling.

technicalNotes.headline: How will operations read the state?
technicalNotes.body: Make delayed data, loss of link and genuine incidents distinguishable.

technicalNotes.headline: Review the exception path
technicalNotes.body: Scope the architecture before the next remote failure or truck roll.
